```objc @implementation CustomSearchController { CustomSearchBar *customSearchBar; } // Override this property to return your custom implementation. - (UISearchBar *)searchBar { // Lazily initialize your custom search bar. if (!customSearchBar) { customSearchBar = [[CustomSearchBar alloc] init]; } return customSearchBar; } @end ```
